newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Zim Israel Navigation confirms Sebba as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Zim Israel Navigation confirms Sebba as CEO.

text.p: Zim Israel Navigation Co's board of directors said on Thursday it has accepted the suggestion of the Israel Corp and confirmed the appointment of Yoram Sebba as Zim president and chief executive.
Sebba has been acting president and CEO since January.

Chairman Amos Mar-Haim said Sebba has helped improve the company's financial results by increasing efficiency and savings, enlarging the circle of clients and boosting the amount of cargo carried by the company.
Zim, one of the largest container shipping companies in the world, is owned by the Israel Corp and the Israeli government.
